DriveGuardian

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 30 June 2026

DriveGuardian ("we", "our", or "the app") helps drivers stay focused on the road and stay accountable. This Privacy Policy explains what information the app collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. By using DriveGuardian you agree to this policy.

Information we collect

  • Account information. Your name and email address when you create an account (including via Google sign-in), used to identify you and secure your data.
  • Location data. Your device's location and speed are used to detect when you are driving and to label activity with the speed at which it occurred.
  • Motion data. Accelerometer readings are used on-device to tell whether you are stationary, walking, or driving.
  • Device token. A push-notification token (Firebase Cloud Messaging) so we can send safety notifications.

How we use your information

  • To detect distracted-driving moments and calculate your safety score.
  • To show you activity breakdowns and weekly reports.
  • To send accountability summaries to partners you choose to add.
  • To send you safety-related notifications.

Accountability partners

If you add an accountability partner, we send that person summary information about your safe-driving activity to the email you provide. Partners do not receive your location, messages, or call details — only high-level safe-driving summaries. You can remove a partner at any time.

How your information is stored and shared

Your data is stored securely using Supabase (our backend provider) and is protected so that only you — and partners you explicitly add — can access your safe-driving summaries. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not show ads. We only share data with service providers that help operate the app, and where required by law.

Permissions we request

  • Location (incl. background): to detect driving and record speed.
  • Physical activity: to refine motion detection.
  • Notifications: to deliver safety alerts.

You can revoke any permission at any time in your device settings; some safety features may stop working as a result.

Data retention

We keep your activity data for as long as your account is active so we can show your history and trends. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.

Your rights

You may access, correct, or delete your personal data. To make a request, contact us at the email below.

Children's privacy

DriveGuardian is intended for licensed drivers and is not directed at children under 13.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.

Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, contact us at support@driveguardian.app.
